question.:question/problem:
Find the entry ${r}_{24}$ of the matrix $R$, where 

$$
R=\begin{bmatrix}-6 & -8 & 1 & -12 \\ -1 & -12 & \sqrt{3} & -3 \\ 7 & 5 & 6 & -1 \\ -6 & -11 & 7 & -5\end{bmatrix}.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The entry ${r}_{24}$ lies at the intersection of the $2$nd row and $4$th column. Therefore, ${r}_{24}=-3.$

$$
R=\begin{bmatrix}-6 & -8 & 1 & -12 \\ -1 & -12 & \sqrt{3} & -3 \\ 7 & 5 & 6 & -1 \\ -6 & -11 & 7 & -5\end{bmatrix}
$$
